notes: New: Client consultation (File menu). Build a personal page for a customer with their project outline and requirements, your latest design ideas and a note from you.

Create link puts the page online at a private address and gives you a link to send by WhatsApp, text or email. The customer clicks through a personal slideshow at their own pace, then answers every idea with Love it, Not for me or See more like this, plus comments. At the end they can watch it as a film with the promo tune, and save a copy.
Their Submit button opens WhatsApp with the whole reply already written to your number. Paste it into the app and the answers fill in on each idea. Email still works as a backup.
Close link takes the page offline once you have their reply. Start the next round with the loved ideas and their own pictures carried over.
Needs the Start Imagination Studio window and a one-time GitHub setup. Saved in the customer folder next to the app.
